terminos.intro: Cuarto Propio is a personal space to write, collect and keep your everyday life. By using it you accept these terms, written in plain language.

secciones.texto: You need a verified email and a password to sign in. Keep your password safe: what happens inside your account is your responsibility.

Everything you write, upload or record remains yours. You only give us permission to store it and show it to you, including making lighter versions of your photos so they load fast. We don't publish it or share it with anyone.
Only keep content that is yours or that you have the right to keep. Don't use Cuarto Propio for anything illegal, and don't try to access other accounts or overload the service.

This is a personal project in its first stage, running on free plans: it may have occasional downtime and a storage limit (we'll warn you when you get close). Photos can be up to 25 MB and audio up to 50 MB or 10 minutes.
There's no trash: deleting is permanent. Data export isn't available yet.
The service is provided as is. Keep your own backups of anything important to you.
You can ask for your account and all its content to be deleted by writing to [CONTACT EMAIL].
If these terms change, the date above is updated. Important changes are announced inside the app.

privacidad.intro: What you keep here is personal and intimate. This page explains what we store, where and why. In short: only so that you can see it.

secciones.texto: Your email and password (encrypted, handled by Supabase Auth). Your name and profile photo, if you add them. Your journal entries, lists, photos (thumbnail and full size), voice notes, categories and hashtags.
Your journal draft while you write and your light or dark mode preference are saved in the browser. We only use the cookies needed to keep you signed in.
Only to show you your own content. Never to train artificial intelligence, for third-party analytics or for advertising. We don't sell or share your data.
On Supabase (database, files and authentication) and Vercel (where the app runs). Everything travels encrypted over HTTPS, and every record is protected so only your account can read it.
We only email you about your account: to confirm sign-up and to recover your password.
For as long as you have the account. What you delete is deleted permanently; the database's automatic backups renew on their own according to the provider's schedule.
You can view, correct and delete your content from the app. To delete the whole account, write to [CONTACT EMAIL].

bienvenida.titulo: This is your room of your own
bienvenida.texto: A place just for you to write, collect and keep your everyday life. Nobody else sees what you keep here.
bienvenida.consejo: To start anything, tap “Create”. Your photo, name and light or dark mode are in your profile, top right.

tema.void: Y2K emo: 2000s desktop windows, stars, glitter and chrome titles.
